records.name: Zalizniak 2020 2590
records.author: Zalizniak, Anna A. and Smirnitskaya, Anna and Russo, Maksim and Mikhailova, Tatiana and Bobrik, Marina and Gruntov, Ilya and Orlova, Maria and Bibaeva, Maria and Voronov, Mikhail
records.upstream_description: The list presents the 2020 version of the Database of Semantic Shifts, from which the major shifts were automatically extracted on 07/10/2020. It expands upon the earlier list taken from Bulakh et al. (2013). The aim of of the Database of Semantic Shifts is to collect and classify semantic shifts attested in the languages of the world. The original data contains some ambiguous glosses enclosed in < and > symbols, which we deliberately ignored here. Since node identifiers in the source database have changed recently, we have removed the links to the source database from this list and refer to Zalizniak et al. (2024) for a more current record.

records.name: Zhong 2022 664
records.author: Zhong, Yin and Wan, Mingyu and Ahrens, Kathleen and Huang, Chu-Ren
records.upstream_description: This list includes ratings across six perceptual modalities (touch, hearing, smell, taste, vision, and interoception) and five action effectors (mouth/throat, hand/arm, foot/leg, head excluding mouth/throat, and torso) rated by Chinese native speakers. The ratings were based on a scale from 0 (no feelings at all) to 5 (very strong feelings).
